summary: Axis-aligned bounding box overlap test. The this box is stored as four __int16 values: min X, min Y, width/span X (this+0x4), height/span Y (this+0x6); the query box is given as its min X, min Y, width and height as four int arguments. Both axes are clamped to the shared interval; if the clamped X span is non-positive the boxes cannot overlap, otherwise the function returns whether the clamped Y span is positive.

operations.description: Compute this box upper X bound: v6 = this[0] + this[2] (min X plus X span at this+0x4).
Clamp lower X: v5 = max(this[0], a2); the shared lower bound cannot be below the query box lower X.
Clamp upper X: v6 = min(this[0] + this[2], a2 + a4); the shared upper bound cannot exceed the query box upper X.
Early-out: if v6 - v5 <= 0 the X intervals do not overlap; return false.
Compute this box upper Y bound: v8 = this[1] + this[3] (min Y plus Y span at this+0x6).
Clamp lower Y: v7 = max(this[1], a3); the shared lower bound cannot be below the query box lower Y.
Clamp upper Y: v8 = min(this[1] + this[3], a3 + a5); the shared upper bound cannot exceed the query box upper Y.
Return v8 - v7 > 0; both axes overlap only when the clamped Y span is also positive.
